honestExpectation: A title/description change alone does not change indexation state -- umbraco-vs-wordpress remains CRAWLED_NOT_INDEXED (an INDEX_SELECTION problem, Lane B) as of this baseline, and this change cannot be expected to move it to INDEXED. What this change CAN plausibly affect: (1) if/when the page is indexed, its snippet immediately reflects real buyer intent instead of a generic fallback; (2) it strengthens the page's own on-page relevance signal for the 'umbraco vs wordpress' query, which may influence which of the two competing Miloosh URLs (the software page or the comparison page) Google chooses to surface for that query in the future. Both effects are hypotheses, not guaranteed outcomes -- recorded honestly per this mission's own measurement discipline.
